plugin.terminal.ime.description: A native callback of the input method (insert, key, compose) with every field it carries, the typed text and the ranges included.

plugin.terminal.input.description: One input of the terminal with every field it carries; queued is true while the input waits for the session and queue is the number of inputs that wait.

plugin.terminal.input.flush.description: The inputs that waited for the session are sent, count of them.

plugin.terminal.input.overflow.description: An input is refused because the queue of inputs that wait for the session holds max inputs; the input is rejected with an error.

plugin.terminal.session.gate.description: The session gate opened or closed because of the sidecar event named in event; inputs wait while it is closed.

plugin.terminal.session.open.description: The terminal asks the sidecar to open its session with the shell and the working directory.

plugin.terminal.close.description: The terminal ends its session at the removal of the surface.

plugin.terminal.send.description: A message to the sidecar with its whole body.

plugin.terminal.send.result.description: The result of a message to the sidecar; error is <code>: <text> when ok is false.

plugin.terminal.sidecar.event.description: An event of the sidecar with its whole body, before the terminal handles it.

plugin.terminal.region.description: An event of the image region with its type and its whole body, before the terminal handles it.

plugin.terminal.frame.description: The screen hash of a screen message of the sidecar: the surface session, the replay segment and the sequence of the message, the size of the grid and the SHA-256 of the screen as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

plugin.terminal.error.description: An error that the terminal shows in its session status; source names where it came from.
